label: Finding-22
title: affected-sites: Cited text capture no longer carries most of the list
description: The 08:05:59Z text capture (sha c88b8c5f...) has no mention of Edinburgh council, the BBC, online stores or the University of Geneva. The list is only in raw/page.2026-10-22T0755Z.html (summary bullet "Among the impacted sites are Wikipedia, Edinburgh council, many online stores and the BBC") and the Geneva item only in the header image alt text in raw/initial-data.json. The BBC dropped the bullet between 07:55Z and 08:05Z. The assessment should cite the raw file and its sha, and say the bullet was later removed.
